title: b1bc.2: Add DkimConfig struct to smtp/config.rs
description:
What: Add DkimConfig struct to crates/smtp/src/config.rs and integrate it into DeliveryConfig.

Algorithm:
1. Add struct DkimConfig { domain: String, selector: String, key_seed_b64: String, public_key_b64: String } with serde Deserialize/Serialize derives.
2. Add field dkim: Option<DkimConfig> to DeliveryConfig, defaulting to None.
3. No validation logic in this bead — that is b1bc.3.
4. Ensure DkimConfig derives Debug but key_seed_b64 must NOT appear in any log — add a custom Debug impl that redacts key_seed_b64.

Defensive programming:
- key_seed_b64 field must never appear in any tracing! or log! macro — the custom Debug impl must print "[REDACTED]" for that field.
- DeliveryConfig default still works when dkim is absent.

Tests: None in this bead — b1bc.3 covers validation tests.
